name: @pipeworx/mcp-west-virginia-rules

tools.name: search_rules
tools.description: Search West Virginia administrative rules (Code of State Rules) -- the agency regulations that implement WV statutes, e.g. Board of Medicine physician-assistant supervision, nursing practice, professional-licensing requirements. Filter by agency (e.g. "Medicine", "Registered Nurses, WV Board of"), title-series (e.g. "11-01B"), rule-name words, authorizing WV Code citation (e.g. "30-3E-3"), or full text of the rule documents. At least one filter is required. Returns counts by status first, then matching rule versions (active rules first). Use for "what does West Virginia require for X" when the answer is an agency rule rather than a statute; pair with wv_code_section for the statute and read_rule_text for the rule text.

agency.description: Agency name as the register lists it, e.g. "Medicine", "Osteopathic Medicine", "Registered Nurses, WV Board of", "Physical Therapy".

title_series.description: Rule family, e.g. "11-01B" (title 11, series 01B = Board of Medicine physician assistants).

rule_name.description: Words in the rule title, e.g. "physician assistants".

full_text.description: Words to find inside the rule documents, e.g. "collaborative agreement".

full_text_mode.description: any = any of the words (default); literal = exact phrase.

status.description: Restrict by rule status. Omit for all versions (history included).

limit.description: Rule versions to return (default 25, max 100). Counts always cover every match.

tools.name: get_rule
tools.description: Get one West Virginia administrative rule family by title-series (e.g. "11-01B"): every version ever filed with its effective date, status (Active, Historical, Emergency), authorizing statute, and the filing history (modified/agency-approved/legislative-approval filings) with document ids that read_rule_text can open. Use after search_rules to see the current rule and what superseded it.

document.description: Optionally, a rule version document number from search_rules to list that version's filings instead.

tools.name: read_rule_text
tools.description: Read the text of a West Virginia administrative rule filing (the rule as filed). Takes a filing document id from get_rule. Returns the text in pages of characters with total length so long rules can be read in sequence via offset. Filings described "Modified File" are redlines (struck and inserted text both appear, e.g. old and new section numbers side by side); the "Agency Approved" and "Valid" filings are cleaner. Use to quote the exact supervision, scope-of-practice, or licensing requirement.

doc_id.description: Filing document id from get_rule, e.g. 59557.

find.description: Optional: return the passages around this phrase instead of a linear page.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-west-virginia-rules forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the west-virginia-rules pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
